binding.positionDeltasField: Backward-compatible name; values are native samples, absolute when header0x200 is absent.
binding.interpolation: Shortest-arc nlerp for quaternion; linear/clamped alpha for position; single-key/time0 quaternion returned unnormalized.
binding.retarget: Main pose consumer scales samplePosition by targetBindLength/nativeBoneLengthScalar when scalar>f32(0.01), before testing relative flags. Native xmm9 factor is exactly1.

semantics.extracted: Native counts, descriptors, channel samples, timestamps and exact HSKN-name hashes.
semantics.sourceCodeConfirmed: Quaternion xyzw: xyz=u16/32767-1, w=u16/65535. Header0x200 makes position relative to bind; combined0x200+0x400 applies bind*sample quaternion and rotates samplePosition by bindQ before adding bindP. Without0x200, positions and quaternions are absolute. Quaternion interpolation is shortest-arc nlerp, preserving decoded values for single-key/time0.
semantics.inferred: time=u16/65535*duration in seconds, consistent with native time quantization and30Hz key spacing.
semantics.unverified: Original-client playback, world handedness/axis conversion, all tail events and actor-specific motion/state flags. Canonical w is nonnegative; samples have not been normalized, cleaned or altered.
semantics.hash: h=31*h+ord(lowercase character) modulo 2^32; exact matches to HSKN29 bone names.
semantics.sparse: Unmapped bones stay null; extra motion channel is separate; no index-order mapping.
